text:
elaine: sharing a lightweight PRD draft for cross-endpoint scoring + launch checklist. trying to keep it focused — acceptance metrics, edge cases, and a canary plan. feedback pls. https://docs.google.com/draft (link)

mohit: skimmed — high level looks good. main ask: spell out how rerank weight updates interact with embedding model changes.

elaine: good point. proposal: score = alpha * rerank_score + (1-alpha) * sim_score where sim_score uses latest embedding model. alpha default 0.7. canary should pin embedding version and rerank model separately.

frank: +1 on pinning. also add an automated comparator to detect embedding drift by cosine distribution shift (KL or AD test).

sara: can we get concrete acceptance thresholds? e.g. nDCG@10 delta, embedding cosine mean shift, P95 latencies.

elaine: draft thresholds below. open to adjustments:
- nDCG@10: must not drop > 1.5% vs baseline on 3 customer slices
- avg cosine similarity (positive pairs): no drop > 0.02
- P95 end-to-end latency (rerank call + embedding lookup): <= 450ms for Dedicated tier, <= 800ms for Hosted free tier
- cost per 100k requests: <= 20% above baseline during canary

kevin: for latency we should measure from client SDK call to final token — include SDK overhead test. also add a memory/kv cache pressure check.

elaine: added. Edge cases to cover in spec:
- mismatch embedding dims => fallback to resizing heuristic + warning event
- empty context => short-circuit: return fallback ranking (recent activity) and metric flagged
- duplicate docs => dedupe step before rerank with stable tie-breaker
- partial failures (embedding fails) => degrade to rerank-only mode or fallback lightweight model

natalie: what about rollout policy? canary -> staged by customer segment -> full. define canary size and duration.

elaine: proposed rollout:
- Canary 1: internal prod traffic 0.5% for 48h (tracking metrics)
- Canary 2: 2% beta customers for 7d (customer opt-in, watch logs)
- Staged: 10% -> 50% -> 100% daily increments if no regression

frank: add automated rollback trigger rules: any of the acceptance thresholds violated on two consecutive 1h windows or error rate > 0.5% absolute.

mohit: add a migration note: when switching embedding model versions, we should support dual-serving for 72h (both versions compute, system uses stable hash to route) so we can compare or re-index cached entries.

elaine: yep. Also added suggested API contract tweak (optional param):
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query": "...",
  "candidates": ["id1","id2"],
  "rerank_alpha": 0.7,        // optional override
  "embedding_version": "v2.1" // optional pin
}
```
Default behaviour: no pin -> use active embedding version for that customer routing policy.

sara: acceptance test plan idea: synthetic suite + 3 real customer slices (support docs, marketing FAQ, internal KB) with seeded ground truth. run nightly regression and pre-rollout smoke.

elaine: included. Also adding observability hooks: per-request metadata (embedding_version, rerank_model, alpha), KPI dashboards (nDCG, cosine mean, latency P50/P95, cost), and debug endpoint to fetch intermediate scores.

kevin: ops-bot: can you create a runbook stub for rollback and fastest mitigation steps?

ops-bot: created runbook draft: https://internal/runbooks/cross-endpoint-scoring (stub). Actions: disable new rerank route, revert default alpha, pin embedding to older version, alert on runbook channel.

natalie: one last ask — acceptance gating for SDK: update client SDKs to expose rerank_alpha and embedding_version in the next minor. we should coordinate release windows.

elaine: noted. next steps: @mohit to detail embedding-drift detector, @frank to add comparison harness, @sara to finalize test slices, @kevin to add infra metrics + memory checks. I'll update the doc and aim for review next Tue.

mohit: will do — linking a prototype detector repo: https://git.internal/embedding-drift-proto

frank: will add harness. I also want a short smoke command for QA:
```
# smoke test
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -d '{"query":"refund policy","candidates":["D1","D2","D3"]}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
```

sara: thanks all. this is actionable. i'll prep the QA checklist once doc is updated. :thumbsup:

elaine: thanks everyone — will push updated draft in the doc and ping again.
